name: Isha Raman

summary: Passionate AI engineer with 9 years of experience building production-grade ML systems and LLM-powered applications for the HR and recruiting domain. I specialise in designing transparent, auditable AI workflows that bridge the gap between cutting-edge NLP research and real-world recruiter needs. Strong believer in explainable AI for high-stakes decisions like hiring.

experience.title: Senior AI Engineer
